label: Filter
description: Asserts that a JavaScript condition is truthy. The step fails (blocking downstream steps) when the condition is falsy.

expression.description: A JavaScript expression evaluated with `output` (previous step data) and `previousOutputs` in scope. The step fails when the expression is falsy.

fromStep.description: Optional step name whose output is bound to `output`. Defaults to the most recently completed step.

message.description: Optional failure message shown in the logs when the condition is not met.

passed.description: Always true when the step succeeds (condition was met).
